title: VeeR EH2 (chipsalliance/Cores-VeeR-EH2)
_note: chipsalliance/Cores-VeeR-EH2: the dual-threaded successor of VeeR EH1 (swept as veer-eh1) and sibling of EL2 (veer-el2).  Same tree shape as EH1: design/{dbg,dec,dmi,exu,ifu,lib,lsu}, the configs/veer.config perl generator emits config/common_defines.vh (BUILD_PATH), design/include/eh2_def.sv carries the packages.  Excluded as rows: the technology memory wrappers (ram_*, the ICCM/DCCM/IC memory banks) and rvclkhdr, as for EH1.  Three closure facts: (1) the `eh2_param_t` struct typedef lives in the GENERATED config/eh2_pdef.vh, which nothing `include`s -- VeeR's own Makefile lists it as a $unit-scope source between eh2_def.sv and the design, so it is an always_src here (without it Surelog records `pt` with an unsupported typespec and read_slang stops at 'undeclared identifier eh2_param_t').  (2) VERILATOR is defined on purpose: the non-Verilator arm of eh2_lsu_dccm_mem declares `` `define DCCM_BANK (depth, width) `` with a SPACE before the argument list, which the LRM (22.5.1) makes an argument-less macro whose body starts with `(depth, width)` -- Surelog reports it as a syntax error and the wrapper never elaborates; the VERILATOR arm instantiates the technology cell (`RV_DCCM_DATA_CELL) / the parameterised eh2_ram directly.  The only other VERILATOR sites are the ICCM banks (same shape) and beh_lib's clock-gate latch.  (3) design/lib/mem_lib.sv declares every ram_<d>x<w> / ram_be_<d>x<w> model through token-pasting macros (`` module ram_be_``depth``x``width ``), names the closure's module index cannot see, so it is an always_src too (EH2_IC_TAG / EH2_IC_DATA / eh2_ifu_btb_mem instantiate them).
